source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Adjudicators come from the current roster and must be certified and qualified for the categories judged; Championships use only accepted Championship Adjudicators; an NDCA Adjudicator's License is required (Associate or higher; Full Member or Fellow for Championships); officials must be registered with the NDCA; non-resident officials need a current WDC license.

requirement: DanceFlow requirement implementing the body rule: credential records per adjudicator in a future NDCA profile; today unverified items are listed, not cleared.
enforcement_point: Planned (docs/competition/governance/judging-integrity/OD-05-conflicts-design.md section 6B): attestation record and credential records, surfaced through _compoc_blockers_qualifications. Not built.
interpretation_notes: DanceFlow requires only an active team membership and a verified email (audit J-04N/J-05N). Design only (PR-A, section 6B): no credential model, no attestation table, no test; no compliance claimed. Organizer attestation never clears this requirement and is never shown as governing-body certification.
decision_refs: OD-15 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B now, Option A for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
